# rasuvaeff/schema

Install: `composer require rasuvaeff/schema`

Runtime deps: `ext-mbstring`, `rasuvaeff/property-testing-core ^1.2`.

## Rules

- One schema definition powers both validation (`parse()`) and generation
  (`arbitrary()`) — the parity law: everything generated must parse. Pinned
  by the package's own property suite; a change to constraints changes both
  sides in the same commit.
- `default($v)` is validated against the schema at construction
  (InvalidArgumentException on the spot) and stored normalized; implies
  `optional()`.
- Error messages never embed input values — kinds and sizes only (int/float
  bound errors name the bound: `Int must be at least 18`).
- Combinator order: constraints/combinators first, `optional()`/`default()` last.
- Union tries members in declaration order, first success wins.

## API

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Schema\Schema;

$schema = Schema::object([
    'email' => Schema::string()->min(3)->max(254),        // code-point length
    'age' => Schema::int()->min(18)->max(120),
    'score' => Schema::float()->min(0.0)->max(1.0)->allowInt(),  // finite only
    'created_at' => Schema::dateTime()->min($epoch),      // RFC 3339 wire, DateTimeImmutable domain
    'active' => Schema::bool(),
    'kind' => Schema::literal('creator'),                  // strict ===
    'state' => Schema::literals(['pending', 'paid']),      // one of a set, strict ===
    'role' => Schema::enum(Role::class),                   // backed enum
    'meta' => Schema::json(),                              // json_decode domain
    'tags' => Schema::arrayOf(Schema::string()->min(1))->maxCount(20),
    'labels' => Schema::mapOf(Schema::int()),              // string keys
    'parent' => Schema::nullable(Schema::string()),
    'idOrName' => Schema::union([Schema::int(), Schema::string()]),
    'event' => Schema::discriminated('type', [        // tag selects the branch
        'created' => Schema::object(['type' => Schema::literal('created'), 'at' => Schema::dateTime()]),
        'renamed' => Schema::object(['type' => Schema::literal('renamed'), 'to' => Schema::string()]),
    ]),
    'point' => Schema::tuple([Schema::float(), Schema::float()]),
    'bio' => Schema::string()->max(1000)->default(''),     // ≡ optional
    'note' => Schema::string()->optional(),                // key may be absent
], unknown: Unknown::Reject);   // default; Unknown::Strip drops, ::Passthrough keeps
```

### Unknown keys / composition

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Schema\Unknown;

$schema->unknown(Unknown::Strip);              // same shape, another mode
$schema->requireAnyOf('email', 'phone');       // >= 1 present (default counts); accumulates
$schema->extend([...]);                        // add / replace properties
$schema->pick('id', 'email');                  // keep (undeclared name → InvalidArgumentException)
$schema->omit('phone');                        // drop; pick/omit prune requireAnyOf groups
$schema->partial();                            // every key optional; defaults stay
```

Reject → error `Unknown property` at `$.x` (the key is in the path, never in the message), export `additionalProperties:
false`; Strip → dropped, export `true` + `strip` NonRepresentable;
Passthrough → kept raw in the result, export `true`. requireAnyOf error:
`At least one of "email", "phone" is required` at `$`; export `anyOf:
[{required:[email]},{required:[phone]}]` (several groups → `allOf`).

### parse / parseOrThrow

```php
$result = $schema->parse($input);       // ParseResult, never throws on bad input
$result->ok;                            // bool
$result->value;                         // parsed (normalized) value when ok
$result->errors;                        // list<ParseError>

$schema->parseOrThrow($input);          // throws SchemaException (all errors)

$schema->parseJson($json);              // decode + parse; bad JSON → `Invalid JSON (…)` at `$`
$result->orThrow();                     // value or SchemaException
$result->valueOr(null);                 // value or the default, typed TValue|TDefault (Psalm cannot narrow ->value by ->ok)
$result->summary(limit: 3, separator: '; ');  // '$.a msg; $.b msg; (+N more)'; '' when ok
(string) $error;                        // '$.path message'
```

`SchemaException extends InvalidArgumentException` (invalid input, not a
runtime failure) and carries `list<ParseError>` as `$errors`.

Enum: accepts an instance or the backed value, returns the instance.
Object: an absent optional key is absent from the result (not null);
a defaulted key is always present with the normalized default.

### ParseError

```php
$error->segments;                       // list<int|string> — source of truth
$error->toPath();                       // '$.tags[2].name'; non-plain keys quoted: "$['a.b']", "$['0']"
$error->toJsonPointer();                // '/tags/2/name' (RFC 6901)
$error->message;                        // kinds/sizes only, no input values
```

### arbitrary

```php
use Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Random;

$value = $schema->arbitrary()->generate(new Random(42))->value;
// always parses; in property tests: Gen::draw($schema->arbitrary())
```

Mapping: string → `Gen::stringOf(min, max)` / `Gen::stringMatching` for
patterns; enum → `Gen::enum` (instances); union → `Gen::frequency` of members;
transform → `Gen::map` (target-space values, source-space shrinking);
refine → `Gen::filter` (prefer constraints over refinements).

### toWire

```php
$wire = $schema->toWire($value);   // PHP domain → wire form
```

enum instance → backed value; containers recursively; nullable null-safe;
union uses the first member that accepts; a transform's declared `wire`
callback (identity when absent); everything else passes through. The
inverse pair of `arbitrary()`: generated/ parsed PHP values handed to
queues, HTTP and JSON storage.

### Combinators

```php
Schema::int()->transform(
    fn (int $v): string => (string) $v,
    from: ?fn (string $v): int,        // round-trip laws only
    wire: ?fn (string $v): mixed,      // PHP→JSON of the target type
    jsonSchema: ?['type' => 'string'], // declared wire shape — exported as is
);
// Without jsonSchema toJsonSchema() throws in strict mode (the source
// schema would lie about the target type); lenient exports {} + entry.

Schema::int()->min(1)->nullable();     // instance form == Schema::nullable(...)

Schema::string()->refine(fn (string $v): bool => ..., 'message');

Schema::lazy(fn (): SchemaInterface => ...);   // recursion, factory memoized
```

### toJsonSchema

```php
$export = $schema->toJsonSchema();                // strict default
$export = $schema->toJsonSchema(lenient: true);   // {} for codec-less transforms

$export->schema;                      // pure draft 2020-12 fragment
$export->nonRepresentable;            // list<NonRepresentable> ('refine @ $.tags')
$export->assertFullyRepresentable();  // throws listing every entry
```

Fragments: string `{type, minLength, maxLength, pattern, format}`; int
`{type: integer, minimum, maximum}`; bool `{type: boolean}`; literal
`{const}`; enum `{type, enum: [backed values]}`; json `{}`; array
`{type: array, items, minItems, maxItems}`; map `{type: object,
additionalProperties, min/maxProperties}`; object `{type: object,
properties, required, additionalProperties, default}` (default through the
wire seam — an enum instance exports as its backed value); nullable
`{anyOf: [{type: 'null'}, inner]}`; union `{anyOf: [...]}`; refine → inner
schema (honest superset) + entry; transform → declared codec.

### Constraints

- string: `min(int)`, `max(int)`, `regex(string $patternWithoutDelimiters)`
  (the `Gen::stringMatching` convention; eagerly probed for generatability —
  `\z` is rejected, use `$`), `regexUnchecked(string $pattern, ArbitraryInterface
  $generator)` (opt-out for patterns outside the subset: the caller's generator
  must produce matches — build them constructively; export adds a
  `NonRepresentable` `regexUnchecked` entry), `format(Format::Email|Uuid|Url|DateTime|Ipv4)`
  (format and pattern are mutually exclusive; a format + tight bounds can
  empty the value set — generation then fails loudly). Invalid UTF-8 is
  rejected up-front (`String is not valid UTF-8`); a PCRE engine failure is
  reported as `Pattern check failed (PCRE engine error: …)`, never as a
  plain mismatch
- literals: `Schema::literals([...])` — non-empty, strictly distinct, finite;
  error `Expected one of: 'a', 'b'`; export `{enum: [...]}`; generator
  `Gen::elements`
- int: `min(int)`, `max(int)`, `positive()` (>= 1, thin alias of `min(1)`), `nonNegative()` (>= 0),
  `coerce()` (canonical int strings `"5"`/`"-3"` → int; no leading zeros, no `+`, no
  whitespace, no overflow; bounds apply after coercion; export keeps `type: integer`
  + `NonRepresentable` `coerce` entry)
- float: `min(float)`, `max(float)`, `allowInt()` (JSON `1` accepted, normalized
  to `1.0`), `coerce()` (canonical JSON number strings `"1.5"`/`"2"`/`"-3e2"` →
  float); NaN/INF rejected by parse and by bound setters; generator is
  `Gen::floatBetween` over `[min, max)` (both parse bounds inclusive — parity
  holds); export `type: number` with `minimum`/`maximum`
- dateTime: `min(DateTimeImmutable)`, `max(DateTimeImmutable)`; wire form is
  the exact generator shape — RFC 3339 **with milliseconds** and offset
  (`+00:00` or `Z`); rolled-over components (`25:00`) and trailing data are
  rejected; export `type: string, format: date-time` — bounds are not
  representable in pure draft 2020-12, so they add a `NonRepresentable`
  `dateTime bounds` entry; `toWire()` formats the instance back to the
  string. Domain split like a transform: `arbitrary()` yields
  `DateTimeImmutable`, `parse()` takes the wire string — the pinned law is
  the wire round trip, not the direct parse
- arrayOf/mapOf: `minCount(int)`, `maxCount(int)`
- tuple: fixed-length heterogeneous list; parse demands `array_is_list` and
  the exact count; export `prefixItems` + `items: false`
- discriminated: `Schema::discriminated($prop, [tag => ObjectSchema, ...])` —
  every branch MUST declare `$prop` as a **required literal equal to its key**
  (checked eagerly); parse: missing tag → `Discriminator property "p" is
  missing` at `$.p`, unknown tag → `Unknown "p" discriminator value` at `$.p`,
  branch errors keep their full paths; int and string tags work; export is
  `oneOf` (disjoint by construction); generator mixes branches via
  `Gen::frequency`
- union: first success wins in declaration order; on failure the single error
  carries **every** branch error in `ParseError->branches`
  (`list<UnionBranch>`, `->member` + `->error` with its own path), rendered
  indented in `SchemaException` messages; parents prepend their segment to
  branch paths too
- bool: `coerce()` (`"true"`/`"1"` → true, `"false"`/`"0"` → false; case-sensitive;
  anything else rejected)
- object: `unknown(Unknown)` (generator emits only declared keys in every
  mode), `requireAnyOf()`, `extend()`, `pick()`, `omit()`, `partial()`,
  `into(Dto::class)` → `IntoSchema`:
  parsed properties go to the DTO constructor as named arguments (after
  defaults/strip); constructor exception → parse error with class names only;
  export and `toWire()` (over `get_object_vars()`) stay the object's; a DTO
  invariant stricter than the schema breaks the generator
- dateTime generator emits millisecond-precision moments within the bounds
  aligned inwards; bounds inside one millisecond are rejected at construction
- property modifiers: `optional()`, `default(mixed $validated)`

### Psalm plugin

`<pluginClass class="Rasuvaeff\Schema\Psalm\Plugin"/>` in psalm.xml (needs
`vimeo/psalm` ^6 or ^7). `Schema::object([...])` → `ObjectSchema<array{...}>`:
bare/defaulted key `k: T`, `->optional()` `k?: T`, a variable property
`k?: T`, Passthrough → open shape `...<string, mixed>`. Carried by extend/
pick/omit/partial/unknown/requireAnyOf. union/tuple/discriminated/lazy/json
stay mixed/list<mixed>/array<string,mixed>. Unreadable declaration →
`array<string, mixed>`.

### yiisoft/validator bridge

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Schema\Bridge\YiiValidator\SchemaRule;

(new Validator())->validate($data, ['payload' => [new SchemaRule($schema)]]);
// errors at 'payload.items.1.sku'; params: path ('$.items[1].sku'), pointer
// skipOnEmpty / skipOnError / when supported; messages added untranslated
```

### Recipe: event = one schema

```php
public static function schema(): IntoSchema   // IntoSchema<self>
{
    return Schema::object([...], unknown: Unknown::Strip)->into(self::class);
}
self::schema()->parseJson($json)->orThrow();  // fromWire
self::schema()->toWire($this);                // toPayload (reads public props)
RoundTrip::assertWireRoundTrip(self::schema(), Gen::draw(self::schema()->arbitrary()));
```

### Stability (1.x)

Frozen: @api surface, parse semantics, error paths/segments, no input values
in messages, parity + wire laws, toWire as inverse of parse, JSON Schema
dialect and NonRepresentable constructs. May change in a minor: message
texts, exact export fragment for the same set, generator distribution,
anything @internal.

### Testing helpers

`Rasuvaeff\Schema\Testing\RoundTrip` (framework-agnostic, throws
`RoundTripException` with stage + value kinds, never values):

```php
RoundTrip::assertParses($schema, $value);         // law 1: generated parses
RoundTrip::assertWireRoundTrip($schema, $value);  // toWire → parse → toWire lossless
// (needs an invertible tree: no wire-less transform, no overlapping union)
RoundTrip::assertConsumerRoundTrip($schema, $payload, $hydrate, $wire);
// hydrate($payload) succeeds; $schema->toWire($payload) === $wire($object);
// wire → hydrate → wire lossless
```
